description: Use this when the user asks in chat to change the board's brief: its looks, Models, outfits, Locations, references, name, shots and steps, AI model or art direction. Send the complete replacement look list with the brief_id it replaces, keeping each unchanged look's key. Shots or steps: recipe with the complete new shot list (recipe_look_keys for some looks only) or recipe_workflow_id. AI model only: image_model / video_model. Art direction only: art_direction_id. Saves the revised brief on the board; nothing runs. If the result lists problems, fix them all and call again; on revision_conflict, read the board and revise its current brief.

LookInput.description: One look: one outfit worn in the shoot, with who wears it and where.

key.description: update_brief: an existing look's key, to keep that look.

label.description: The look's name, e.g. 'Linen summer set'.

model_id.description: The Model who wears the look.

reference_ids.description: Reference photos (uploaded file ids from the board's References).

ProposedDirection.description:
The shoot's Direction as the host writes it: its words, a saved art direction, or both; never neither
(``NO_DIRECTION``), so every brief says what runs.

art_direction_id.description: A saved art direction (a library id, or the id save_art_direction returns).

prompt.description: Your words for this shoot, in English, 1-3 sentences. Write one direction for every look from what the user wants (setting, light, mood, poses, purpose). Never name a garment, model, location or look: the same words run on every look. Not needed with an art_direction_id.

RecipeSpec.description: The recipe a demand asks for: its shots and their steps.

image_model.description: A listed image model's slug, only when the user named it.

name.description: What the automation is for, 1-3 words, e.g. 'PDP', 'Lookbook', 'Campaign': Uwear names it with its views and steps ('PDP · front, side, upper').

shots.description: One shot per view, in order.

video_model.description: A listed video model's slug, only when the user named it.

ShotSpec.description: One photo of each look, from one camera.

camera.description: The view, from the camera list.

then.description: Steps on this shot's photo, in order (a video ends the chain).

StepSpec.description: One step on a shot's photo (or on the step before it).

camera_edit_id.description: camera_edit only: the view, one of full_body_front, full_body_back, full_body_side, upper_body_front, upper_body_back, upper_body_side, lower_body_front, lower_body_back, lower_body_side, clothing_detail_front, clothing_detail_back, clothing_detail_side.

factor.description: upscale only: the upscale factor, e.g. 2.

kind.description: camera_edit: the same photo from another view (camera_edit_id); edit: a written change (prompt); upscale: a larger photo; video: a clip opening on the photo (prompt: the motion); remove_background: the subject on transparency.

length_seconds.description: video only: the video length in seconds.

prompt.description: edit: the change; video: the motion (optional).

sound.description: video only: whether the video has sound.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

brief_id.description: The brief being revised: the board's brief_id from read_shoot_board.

direction.description: A new Direction for the whole shoot, replacing the brief's (omit: kept): prompt, art_direction_id (a saved art direction), or both. Write one direction for every look from what the user wants (setting, light, mood, poses, purpose). Never name a garment, model, location or look: the same words run on every look.

image_model.description: A listed image model's slug the user asked for ("use GPT Image"): the shoot's AI model, every shot and edit of every look runs on it; the automation is unchanged. Not with recipe (name it in recipe.image_model).

looks.description: The complete new look list (not a diff); an unchanged look keeps its key.

recipe.description: The complete new shots and steps, built as a new automation for the looks below (e.g. the old shots plus a side view). Not with recipe_workflow_id.

recipe_look_keys.description: The looks (keys you send) that move to recipe / recipe_workflow_id; omit for every look.

recipe_workflow_id.description: An automation from read_shoot_board's brief_inputs.automations for the looks below. Not with recipe.

title.description: A new name for the shoot, only the user's own words (omit: kept).

video_model.description: A listed video model's slug the user asked for: the shoot's videos run on it. Not with recipe (name it in recipe.video_model).

name: update_brief
title: Revise Brief
